title: [Main] Incorrect Buyer/Seller Registration No. Written to Detailed GST Ledger Entry When Posting Purchase Invoice Without Order Address
summary: Fixed incorrect registration numbers appearing in GST ledger entries when purchase invoices are posted without order addresses by resetting cached values between postings.
key_points: Detailed GST Ledger Entries showed previous invoice's registration number when subsequent invoice had no Order Address
Root cause was single-instance codeunit retaining values between postings in the same session
Solution resets cached Pay-to Vendor No., Buyer/Seller Registration No., and State Code before each document posting
Affects Indian GST purchase posting workflow
quote: Reset cached Pay-to Vendor No., Buyer/Seller Registration No., and State Code before initializing each purchase document's posting values.
